hook_text: Six countries share a border with South Africa. Can you name them all?
clip_script: Kimberley, Northern Cape. A big map, a toy car, and a challenge: visit every neighbour. North-west to Namibia and Windhoek. North to Botswana and Gaborone. North-east to Zimbabwe and Harare. Along the coast to Mozambique and Maputo. Into the hills of Eswatini and Mbabane. And into the mountains of Lesotho, surrounded by South Africa, to Maseru. Six neighbours, six capitals, all working together in SADC.
visual_style: Whiteboard map of southern Africa with a little car driving a dotted route, stopping at a star for each capital city.
mood: Fun and adventurous, like a family road trip.
pacing: One stop per neighbour, quick and rhythmic, ending back home.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and draw your own road trip to all six neighbours.
